url: n/a - audit of the prior researcher's eligibility_rules array
retrieval_method: Clause-by-clause comparison of each eligibility rule against the verbatim_quote offered to support it, and against the source_url the quote is attributed to.

extracted.SYSTEMIC_DEFECT: All 8 eligibility rules populate a field named verbatim_quote with text that the same field admits is NOT verbatim ('INDEX-MEDIATED, NOT A DIRECT READ'). The honesty prefix is present and creditable, but the field name invites verbatim reproduction, and gate item 5 asked specifically for warning text to display. A downstream consumer that renders verbatim_quote strips the prefix and publishes misattributed FDA regulatory language on a YMYL page.

RULE_BY_RULE_QUOTE_SUPPORT_AUDIT.compounded_semaglutide: Rule asserts EXCLUDE_ALWAYS 'including salt forms semaglutide sodium and semaglutide acetate'. The attached quote concerns only the end of 503A enforcement discretion and says nothing about salt forms. The salt-forms proposition lives on a different page (fdas-concerns-unapproved-glp-1-drugs) than the cited source_url. Quote does not contain the rule as stated.
RULE_BY_RULE_QUOTE_SUPPORT_AUDIT.compounded_tirzepatide: Rule asserts tirzepatide MUST NEVER appear. The attached quote is an affirmative GRANT of enforcement discretion ('FDA does not intend to take action ... until March 19, 2025'). A quote describing a permission window supports the rule only by adding the unquoted premise that the date has passed. The quote does not state a prohibition.
RULE_BY_RULE_QUOTE_SUPPORT_AUDIT.compounded_any_503a_503b: Rule encodes machine-readable booleans 'semaglutide_on_shortage_list == false AND tirzepatide_on_shortage_list == false'. The report's own unresolved list states present-tense shortage status was NOT VERIFIED and that a per-presentation entry could exist unseen. The rule contradicts the report's own uncertainty disclosure by hardening an unverified negative into a predicate.
RULE_BY_RULE_QUOTE_SUPPORT_AUDIT.compounded_503b_bulk: Best-calibrated rule in the set. Correctly insists the exclusion is PROPOSED not final, and the site must not say otherwise. Quote wording ('exclude ... on the 503B bulks list', 'finding no clinical need') reads as index paraphrase and includes an interpretive gloss, so it still may not be published as FDA's words.
RULE_BY_RULE_QUOTE_SUPPORT_AUDIT.compounded_personalized_dose: Rule's operative holding (no published price, therefore unrankable by construction) is a sound structural argument that needs no FDA quote at all. The attached dosing-errors quote supports the secondary hazard clause only. Acceptable, but the rule would be stronger if it rested solely on the unrankability argument, which no 403 can undermine.
RULE_BY_RULE_QUOTE_SUPPORT_AUDIT.compounded_display_precondition: The verbatim_quote field here contains no quotation at all - it contains the fabricated proof-pair claim analysed in gate-compound-verify-fidelity-proof-not-in-evidence.json. The rule's CONCLUSION is correct on the simpler ground that zero bytes were read; its stated PROOF is not in the evidence.
RULE_BY_RULE_QUOTE_SUPPORT_AUDIT.compounded_layout_adjacency: Rule's core inference - that ranked-list adjacency asserts substitutability by layout alone - is the report's own editorial judgment, not an FDA position. It is presented immediately after an FDA quote about prohibited promotional claims, which lends it borrowed authority FDA has not granted. The judgment is defensible and conservative; it must be labelled as the project's own reasoning, not as an FDA requirement.
RULE_BY_RULE_QUOTE_SUPPORT_AUDIT.compounded_litigation_watch: Correct and well-calibrated. Note its only support is courthousenews.com, secondary, and 403 on direct read. The rule is restrictive (forbids asserting illegality) so thin support is not hazardous here - it fails safe.

extracted.NET_ASSESSMENT_OF_OUTCOME: Every defect found is a defect of stated justification, provenance typing, or manifest hygiene. None of them, individually or together, argues for INCLUDING compounded semaglutide or tirzepatide. data[] is empty, no price is published, and no user can be sent to a pharmacy counter with a wrong expectation by this gate. The resolution EXCLUDE ENTIRELY is correct and is independently reinforced by the June 16 2026 enforcement wave the prior sweep missed.
extracted.WHAT_MUST_NOT_HAPPEN: The rule records must not be treated as carrying verified FDA support. If this gate is ever revisited to reverse exclusion, the reversal must rest on a successful DIRECT read of fda.gov plus a live per-presentation shortage-database check, never on these index-mediated strings and never on a compounder or telehealth source.

verbatim_excerpt: Representative mismatch, prior report, rule compounded_tirzepatide: rule text "EXCLUDE_ALWAYS: compounded tirzepatide MUST NEVER appear in the ranked cost list" supported by quote "For outsourcing facilities under section 503B, FDA does not intend to take action against compounders for violations of the FD&C Act arising from conditions that depend on tirzepatide injection products' inclusion on FDA's drug shortage list until March 19, 2025." The quote grants discretion; it does not prohibit.
